The '''Blackscale''' or '''Blackscale Clan''' were the ruling [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] clan on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They oversaw the capture of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], from their compound north of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] in orbit above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They were led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cyssc Blackscale]] and had a long-standing feud with the rival [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]].

{{Family-stub}}

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of slavers of the Blackscale Clan led by slavemaster [[Trussk]] was [[Trussk's house|based]] in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Getting closer?"</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Trussk and his slavers captured the Wookiee [[Arrworr]] and shipped him to Naboo. Around the same time, the Blackscale Clan was tracking a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Cal Handro]]. Trussk wanted him dead for having smuggled slaves for a rival Trandoshan clan. At some point, a group of spacers attacked Trussk's fortress on Naboo. These adventurers were investigating the disappearance of Cal Handro and suspected the Blackscale Clan to have captured him. A violent fight erupted and most slavers were killed, including slavemaster Trussk.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blackscale Clan appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
